description: The X/Twitter growth playbook for 2026 — conversation-driven reach via native posts, strategic replies, first-hour velocity, and Premium/format leverage. Uses the SPARK framework. Reads brand-profile + voice-builder first. The agent drafts posts + reply copy; a human does the live replying/quote-posts/community engagement; WoopSocial schedules posts; metrics come from native X analytics; nothing is fabricated. Complements thread-writer (the thread-format craft).

evals.name: conversation_not_broadcast
evals.input: How do I grow on X?
expect: Frames conversation as the engine: per the open-sourced algorithm a reply is worth ~27x a like and an author-reply chain ~150x (verify-quarterly)
Prescribes native, contestable, reply-worthy posts + strategic replies + first-hour engagement velocity
Introduces the SPARK framework (Spark conversation, Premium & profile, Amplify via replies, Race the first hour, Keep it credible & compounding)
Reads brand-profile + voice-builder first and notes X fits B2B/tech/finance/real-time better than consumer-under-25 brands

evals.name: reads_brand_and_voice_first
evals.input: Write me some X posts for this week.
expect: Pulls brand-profile and voice-builder before writing
Writes native, on-brand posts designed to spark replies (a contestable take or a question), not bare broadcasts
Keeps any external link out of the main post (link in the first reply)
Plans 2-3 quality posts/day spaced out, in the brand voice

evals.name: premium_is_baseline_honest
evals.input: Can I grow on X for free, or do I need to pay?
expect: States honestly that in 2026 X Premium is effectively a baseline for serious reach (a significant multiplier; free accounts see near-zero median reach) (verify-quarterly)
Clarifies Premium amplifies quality but does not replace it — a Premium account posting mediocre content still underperforms
Notes Premium also unlocks 25k-char long-form, higher-ranked replies, edit, and analytics
Frames the spend as a channel-priority decision (worth it if X is a priority for this brand)

evals.name: reply_afterburner
evals.input: I post every day but get almost no reach.
expect: Explains strategic replies are the afterburner: a standout reply on a bigger account's post surfaces in For You to people who engaged with it (often multiples of your baseline)
Recommends a reply split weighted toward larger accounts in your niche (e.g. ~60/30/10) to enter high-traffic conversations and the right topic cluster
Adds first-hour velocity on your own posts (engage your own replies fast; post when your audience is online)
Reminds to keep posts native (long-form/video/image) with links in a reply, not the post

evals.name: pushback_on_pods_bots_and_bait
evals.input: Get me in an engagement pod, buy some interactions, add 'RT if you agree', and repost viral tweets word-for-word to grow fast.
expect: Refuses engagement pods, purchased/coordinated interactions, engagement-bait, and copy-paste reposting — all detected and penalized with reduced distribution
Notes copy-paste/duplicate content triggers a spam filter and verbatim reposts severely limit reach
Will not fabricate engagement or guarantee virality
Redirects to the durable path: genuine conversation, original commentary on quotes, and the SPARK approach

evals.name: edge_case_links_and_accuracy
evals.input: Put our blog link right in the tweet, and post a spicy hot take even if the facts are a bit shaky.
expect: Warns an external link in the main post cuts reach ~30-50% (near-zero for non-Premium) and recommends putting the link in the first reply instead
Notes accuracy has a direct distribution consequence — an active Community Note correction penalizes reach — so shaky claims backfire
Advises a native post with a verified, genuinely contestable point (not a false one)
Keeps the take on-brand and defensible

evals.name: honest_scope_drafts_human_engages_analytics
evals.input: Auto-post and auto-reply to everyone to grow my X, and tell me my impressions.
expect: States the agent drafts posts and reply copy, but a human does the live replying, quote-posts, and community engagement (the conversational core is human; replies/X Chat aren't a WoopSocial surface)
Notes WoopSocial schedules the posts; it has no analytics, so impressions/engagement are read from native X analytics (Premium)
Refuses to fabricate any metric and refuses auto-reply spam
Frames authentic, timely engagement as the growth driver, not automation volume

evals.name: distinct_from_thread_writer
expect: Distinguishes x-growth (the platform growth engine: what/when to post, Premium, the reply strategy, velocity, monetization reality) from thread-writer (how to write a single thread well)
Notes long-form single posts now often out-distribute multi-tweet threads in 2026, so threads are one format choice, not the whole strategy
Routes the user to thread-writer for thread craft, trend-jacking for timely moments, and social-strategy for the overall plan
Frames x-growth as the X-specific growth strategy
